{{Short description|Austrian mathematician (born 1941)}}
'''Wilfried Imrich''' (born 25 May 1941) is an Austrian mathematician working mainly in [[graph theory]]. He is known for his work on [[graph product]]s, and authored the books ''Product Graphs: Structure and Recognition'' (Wiley, 2000, with [[Sandi Klavžar]]),<ref>Review of ''Product Graphs: Structure and Recognition'' by Pranava K. Jha (2001), {{MR|1788124}}.</ref> ''Topics in graph theory: Graphs and their Cartesian Products'' (AK Peters, 2008, with Klavžar and Douglas F. Rall),<ref>Listing for ''Graphs and their Cartesian Products'', {{MR|2468851}}.</ref> and ''Handbook of Product Graphs'' (2nd ed., CRC, 2011, with Klavžar and Richard Hammack).<ref>Listing for ''Handbook of Product Graphs'', {{MR|2817074}}.</ref>

Imrich earned his doctorate from the [[University of Vienna]] in 1965, under the joint supervision of [[Nikolaus Hofreiter]] and [[Edmund Hlawka]].<ref>{{mathgenealogy|name=Wilfried Imrich|id=20354}}</ref>
He has worked as a researcher for IBM in Vienna, as an assistant professor at [[TU Wien]] and the [[University at Albany, SUNY]], as a postdoctoral researcher at [[Lomonosov University]], and, since 1973, as a full professor at the [[University of Leoben]] in Austria.<ref name="ae"/> He retired in 2009, becoming a [[professor emeritus]] at Leoben.<ref>[http://www.gregas.eu/members/ap/wilfried-imrich Project member biography], EuroGIGA, retrieved 2016-12-10.</ref> He is on board of advisors of the journal ''[[Ars Mathematica Contemporanea]]''. Since 2012 he has been a member of the [[Academia Europaea]].<ref name="ae">[http://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Imrich_Wilfried Member profile], [[Academia Europaea]], retrieved 2016-12-10.</ref>
